name: reshmas-art-gallery
description: Production inventory management application for Reshma's Art Gallery

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:android: npm run build:client && npm run cap:sync --prefix client
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:android && cd client/android && powershell -Command "$env:ANDROID_PREFS_ROOT=$null; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug"

author: Reshma's Art Gallery
